fields.label: Footer Note
fields.default: This document contains confidential medical information intended only for the named recipient.

fields.label: Drug Item Group
fields.description: Only items in this group (and its sub-groups) appear when prescribing.

fields.label: Pharmacy Warehouse
fields.description: Dispensed drugs are issued from this warehouse and stock here decides what can be prescribed.

fields.label: Lock Screen After (minutes)
fields.description: Idle time before the clinic screens lock and ask for the user's PIN. 1 to 240. Applies from the next page load.

fields.label: First Aid Supplies Item Group
fields.description: Dressings and other kit supplies. These and the clinic drugs can be issued to first aid kits.

fields.label: Cost Centre for Stock Entries
fields.description: Used for the stock entries the clinic creates. Leave empty to use 'Clinic - <company abbreviation>' or the company default.

fields.label: Clinic Access Administrator
fields.description: The only person who can give or take away clinic roles. While this is empty, a Clinic Manager can claim it for themselves; after that only this person can change it. A clinic_access_admin entry in the site config, if there is one, always takes priority.

fields.label: Clinic Biometric Device ID
fields.description: The device ID exactly as it appears on Employee Checkin (one per line). Punches from this device are labelled Clinic Check-in / Clinic Check-out and listed on the clinic Attendance tab.

fields.label: Clinic Staff Using This Device
fields.description: Staff who work at the clinic and are never patients (for example the doctor). Their punches on this device are not clinic visits: they stay out of the clinic Attendance tab and go to HR attendance as usual.
